title: Inert foreground ActionJournal helper and local pipe ABI

bootstrap.source: one inherited anonymous pipe exposed as standard input
bootstrap.encoding: fixed little-endian binary header followed by bounded UTF-16 fields

layout.magic_0_15: LAEJRNHELPBOOT followed by two NUL bytes
layout.total_bytes_u32_20: 192 plus both exact UTF-16LE byte lengths
layout.tail_192: storage directory then image path as exact UTF-16LE without terminators

bootstrap.secret_policy: exactly 32 key bytes and 16 nonce bytes; read once, locked where supported, zeroed after session; never argv, environment, disk, pipe name, receipt, or error

issuer_authority.current_slice: refused before bootstrap read because no authenticated supervisor image trust anchor is configured
issuer_authority.os_binding: retain the inherited anonymous-pipe read handle; GetNamedPipeServerProcessId must identify one live retained same-user same-session issuer process
issuer_authority.required_activation_binding: the retained issuer process image must be authenticated against a signed release manifest/trust anchor that is not supplied in bootstrap data
issuer_authority.self_asserted_identity: never sufficient; PID, file identity, path, key, or nonce carried in bootstrap cannot authenticate its writer

storage.lease: open_existing through the merged Win32 boundary before named-pipe creation and retain the complete lease for helper lifetime
storage.single_authority: all startup scan, recovery, append, summary, and detail operations use only the retained file handle
storage.startup: before pipe creation, a shared 15000 ms monotonic deadline and retained-supervisor liveness cancellation probe cover the complete strict 1024-slot/two-bank scan and every recovery append
storage.recovery: prepared and authorized append startup_recovery/cancelled; dispatching, acknowledged, and reconciling append startup_recovery/unknown_manual; terminal and unknown remain unchanged
storage.io: synchronous retained-handle ReadFile, WriteFile, and FlushFileBuffers execute on a dedicated targeted thread; CancelSynchronousIo plus a 2000 ms settlement grace is checked, and unproved cancellation heap-retains its duplicate handle/buffer while poisoning and terminating the helper
storage.persisted_authority: authorization_kind and resolution are decoded only from the exact finite protocol enums; unknown, empty-string, or wrong-typed values make the bank corrupt
commit: validate exact protocol event and transition plus capacity before write
write full staging marker through explicit-offset handle I/O
FlushFileBuffers and exact readback plus checksum validation
enter noncancellable section no later than this write

pipe.name: fixed prefix plus decimal helper PID; contains no key or nonce
pipe.security: protected nondefaulted DACL with one noninherited allow ACE for the exact current process-token user SID
identity: retained PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE handle reports exact PID and creation time
client TokenSessionId and ProcessIdToSessionId equal bootstrapped session
QueryFullProcessImageName path equals bootstrapped canonical path
retained no-follow image handle has exact bootstrapped volume serial and 128-bit file ID
pipe.identity_lifetime: retain client process and image handles until disconnect

transport.overlapped: every pipe connect/read/write uses an event-backed OVERLAPPED and CancelIoEx on deadline/cancel; storage uses separately targeted CancelSynchronousIo; incomplete cancellation or completion is fatal
transport.authentication: HMAC-SHA256 over exact merged canonical frame bytes with constant-time comparison
transport.sequence: independent inbound and outbound monotonic sequence beginning at zero
transport.nonce: exact bootstrapped nonce on every frame
transport.replay: duplicate request ID, old sequence, future sequence, wrong nonce, or unsolicited response closes the session
transport.disconnect: close session and zero bootstrap material; never replay a mutation
transport.lost_ack: establish a new supervised session and query detail or repeat only an exact still-prepared prepare; never repeat dispatch or later mutation
transport.queues: fixed-capacity; overflow returns queue_full before mutation or closes when correlation cannot be preserved

cancellation.before_commit: cancel or now greater than or equal to the expired deadline refuses before storage mutation
cancellation.commit_section: staging/body/committed durability sequence is noncancellable once entered
cancellation.during_commit: return commit_non_cancellable only after commit outcome is known when transport remains available; otherwise disconnect and require detail
cancellation.after_disconnect: startup recovery/query determines durable state; no action replay

receipts.allowed: only merged finite redacted protocol response envelopes and helper health status

acceptance_gates: remote Windows SDK compilation with warnings-as-errors and static analysis
exact Windows named-pipe SID/session/PID/image and adversarial race tests
exact NTFS crash, power-loss, filter-driver, antivirus, and FlushFileBuffers evidence
supervisor inherited-handle bootstrap and job-tree lifecycle integration
Node transport integration without secret/path exposure
package allowlist, dependency scan, signing/provenance, and exact target acceptance
